title: Old Fashioned French Beef Fillet Wrap
description: A traditional Brittany dish featuring tender beef fillet wrapped in leafy greens and steamed to perfection, this recipe is a comforting and flavorful treat. It is also shojin-friendly, making it accessible to those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef fillet with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Melt one tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium heat and sear the beef fillet until browned on all sides.
Wrap the beef fillet in kale leaves, making sure to cover it completely.
Place the wrapped beef fillet in a steamer basket and steam for 10 minutes.
Melt the remaining tablespoon of butter and brush it over the kale leaves.
Return the beef fillet to the oven and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the beef fillet rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
